title: 4f-Metal Clusters Exhibiting Slow Relaxation of Magnetization: A {Dy7} Complex with An Hourglass-like Metal Topology

material_class.structural_family: hourglass-like {Dy7} core of two vertex-sharing {Dy4(μ3-OH)3(μ3-OMe)} cubanes

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, solid Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (0.09 g, 0.20 mmol) was added to a stirred yellow solution of nacbH2 (0.07 g, 0.20 mmol) and NEt3 (84 μL, 0.60 mmol) in MeOH/MeCN (20 mL, 5:1 v/v). The orange-yellow suspension was stirred for 30 min until all solids dissolved, then filtered. The filtrate was left to evaporate slowly at room temperature. After ten days, X-ray quality yellow needle-like crystals of 1·5MeOH·MeCN were collected by filtration, washed with cold MeOH (2 × 2 mL) and MeCN (2 × 2 mL), and dried in air for 24 h. The air-dried solid analyzed as 1·MeOH. Isolated yield 40% based on ligand.
synthesis.time: stirred 30 min; crystals after 10 days; dried in air 24 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic stirring followed by filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate evaporated slowly at room temperature; yellow needle crystals of 1·5MeOH·MeCN collected, washed with cold MeOH (2 × 2 mL) and MeCN (2 × 2 mL), and air-dried 24 h (air-dried solid 1·MeOH)

properties.summary: Heptanuclear Dy(III) cluster 1·MeOH shows χMT close to seven noninteracting Dy(III) ions at 300 K, a low-T decline attributed to crystal-field depopulation and weak intramolecular antiferromagnetic coupling, unsaturated anisotropic magnetization, and zero-dc-field SMM-like slow relaxation with a very small barrier (~5 K) dominated by fast QTM rather than an Orbach process.

measurements.name: magnetization at 7 T
measurements.conditions: 1.9–5 K magnetization vs field; no saturation at 7 T (expected MS 70 NμB)

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: ac susceptibility, Hdc = 0, Hac = 3.0 G, 3–1000 Hz; Kramers–Kronig/Debye fit of χ″/χ′

measurements.name: τ0
measurements.conditions: same zero-dc-field ac fit as Ueff
